alloy.started_by: deploy.sh, observability profile enabled by /srv/pathable/secrets/grafana-cloud.env (mode 0600; keys and the non-secret URL and user verified without printing the file)
alloy.result: crash loop: 11 restarts, every one 'failed to create the remotecfg service: mkdir /var/lib/alloy/data: permission denied'. Stopped with docker stop; nothing was scraped or remote-written.
alloy.cause: grafana/alloy:v1.21.2 runs as root; /var/lib/alloy is uid 473, mode 0770; compose drops every capability, so root cannot enter it
alloy.fix: run as the image's own user, user: "473:473" (fix/alloy-run-as-its-user)
alloy.fix_proven_on_host: throwaway containers with the same flags and a minimal config: root exited 1 with the same error; uid 473 stayed running. Both removed.
